parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the encryption parameter. The name must be 1 to 180 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). It cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, ALICLOUD, or OOS.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos delete-secret-parameter --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MySecretParameter --region cn-hangzhou
